name: typographic-bw
summary: Flat black / flat white polarity-flipping typographic look: huge tight bold sans wordmarks in pure white or a blue-to-pink gradient, extruded roman-numeral slabs with per-slab hue gradients, no bloom, no cards; the white sections carry a drifting pale blue / pink light field at the frame edges.
evidence: R6 t=0.5/1.5/4.0/6.5/9.0/11.5/22.8/28.5 bg median #010101 over the darkest 30 % of pixels (encoder black floor) -> bg #000000; bg luminance 1/255 in every 92x69 cell of a text-free grid at t=0.5, 4.0, 6.5, 11.5, 22.8 -> vignette 0, field glow 0 (flat)

R6 t=13.3/14.0/15.0/21.0 inverse polarity: bg median #FFFFFF-#FDFCFF over the lightest 30 %; slab ink sampled 8x8 at (300,200),(360,200),(425,200) t=21.0 = #1E2022/#1E1F23/#1E1F24 -> surface #1E2022 (white-polarity ink); recorded as the inverse look, not the primary bg
R6 t=0.5/1.5 text: brightest 2 % median #FFFFFF; bg stays 1/255 up to the glyph edge (row y=200 x170-192 at t=0.5, col x=200 above the M) -> text #FFFFFF, textAlpha 1, bloom 0

R6 t=2.5 gradient wordmark 'Made by Google': horizontal gradient, left end top-saturation median #4E83F3 (x 271-285), right end #D65F81 (x 452-466), midpoint #A481D8 -> accent #4E83F3 (blue), accent2 #D65F81 (pink); same pair on the slabs (t=11.5 I3 top #E54949, V bottom #3E5D98; t=22.8 right slab top #5A84F1, left slab bottom #C76BA5)

R6 t=10.5 only non-flat black frame: brightest slab-free 16 px block at (0.45,0.41) mean lum 18.8 = intensity 0.074, colour #0E1323 = #6388FF normalised (blurred slab reflection, beat-level) -> tokens.glow / glowColor #6388FF with field.glow 0

R6 t=13.3 white-section light field (Gaussian r=6, slabs masked L>150 & chroma<110): left edge strip mean #D9E7FF (L 230) = white + 0.20 x #4187FF, right edge strip #F5E4F0 (L 232) = white + 0.17 x #C460A7, centre #FCFCFE (L 252); lum along y=0.08 H: 227 at x=0.02 -> 250 at x=0.26 -> 227 at x=0.98; lobes centred off-frame left/right, full frame height -> glows[0]/[1]. Intensity here = tint mix weight over white (luminance drop 0.09-0.11), not added luminance; white polarity only

R6 t=21.0 (brief said t~22.5, which is a black frame with 'II'): same field drifted — pink top edge #F1DEEE / TL #E8DBF4, blue bottom-right #D6E0FE / bottom edge #DDE7FE, centre-top #FAECF1; t=20.8 blue peak #C3DBFF at (0.86,0.79), pink #F4D2E1 at (0.07,0.52). The lobes move every beat; the JSON profile is the t=13.3 layout
R6 grain: high-pass (img - Gaussian r=3) std over text-free bands = 0.00-0.01 levels on black (t=0.5, 4.0, 6.5, 11.5, 28.5) and 0.10-0.30 levels on white (t=14.0, 21.0) -> grain 0 (max 0.0012)

R6 surfaces derived from the slab faces (no cards, buttons or pills in the clip): t=22.8 row y=200 bg 1 -> 11 -> 118 -> 138 across the slab edge (1-2 px antialias, no border, no under-glow); t=14.0 row y=200 and col x=440 white 255 immediately outside the slab (no shadow); t=22.8 left slab bbox x311-344 y121-301 fully lit from row 122 (square corners, radius 0); slab fills are hue gradients (t=11.5 I1 top #B189E4 -> bottom #9086ED dL -0.009; t=22.8 left top #A583E4 -> bottom #C76BA5 dL +0.105, right dL -0.084) with no consistent lightness lift -> lift 0
